text.title: user-flows.md Template Output Contract
text.summary: The test-spec this methodology produces: `features/in-progress/F0NN-slug/user-flows.md`, one block per flow with five required fields, mapping 1:1 to Playwright spec files. The JSON Schema below is the machine-checkable view of that file; the subagent MUST satisfy it before returning to the caller.

required.field: at least one flow; each with `id` (F-0N), `title`, `actor`, `preconditions`, `happy_path`, `negative_paths`, `playwright_spec`

forbidden.pattern: a flow missing any of the five fields
a flow with zero negative paths
a negative path without a trigger or without the expected error UX
a happy-path step without an expected result
two flows pointing at the same Playwright spec, or a flow with none
user-flows.md present for a backend-only feature (worker, job, cron, migration, API with no UI consumer)

allowed-transformations.transformation: Split one long flow into several F-0N blocks when they map to separate spec files.
Reuse a precondition across flows by restating it; do not reference another flow's block.
Pick the negative case from the unsexy-edge list (auth, network, invalid input, race, boundary) when the spec names none.

list.item: Every flow lists Actor, Preconditions, Happy path, Negative paths, Playwright spec path
Happy path is numbered, every step has an expected result, the success criterion is in the final step
At least one negative path per flow, each with trigger + expected error UX
Every flow points at one spec file; every spec file belongs to one flow
The feature actually has a user-facing flow — otherwise this file must not exist and the work verifies in tests/api/

text.reference: Fillable Markdown template with one-flow stub.
